text: Revenue was ₹6,48,882 from 2,231 sessions, up 12.1% on the previous period.
The busiest hour is 19:00-20:00 with 10.0% of all sessions; Thursday is the busiest weekday (16.7%) and weekends carry 25.8% of sessions.
BKC is the top-earning zone with ₹1,17,883 (14.8% of sessions) across 1 station.
Goregaon is the fastest-growing zone: sessions in the last 30 days are up 69.2% versus the 30 days before.
Rainy days see 9.7% fewer sessions than comparable dry days (heavy rain: -22.1%); public holidays shift demand by -10.2% versus a normal day of the same type.
No-shows are 4.8% and cancellations 8.0% of resolved bookings; bookings made > 3 days ahead are the riskiest (8.4% no-show).

13 stations run below half of the average utilisation (2.1%), e.g. GreenPlug Worli Maple Heights, MetroCharge Worli Harbour View Complex, MetroCharge Goregaon Atlas Mall - candidates for promotions or re-siting.
CCS2 is the most used connector with 40.3% of sessions and ₹3,52,618 revenue.
The biggest drop-off in the booking funnel is SELECT_SLOT -> BOOK: only 75.5% continue.
14.4% of 508 reviews are negative (average rating 4.07/5); the most frequent complaint keyword is "connector".
